text:
people_ops_anna: Quick follow-up thread from today's all-hands pricing segment  leadership is here for quick clarifications about packaging, quotas, credits, and usage policy. Drop short Qs.

eng_kai: Do embeddings have different rate-limit windows than text generation? We have continuous embedding jobs.

cto_jen: Yes  we enforce separate throughput windows for embedding endpoints vs generation. Embeddings are metered by vector units/minute and have conservative per-second concurrency to protect KV stores.

eng_kai: Any recommended pattern for streaming embeddings without hitting per-second caps?

cto_jen: Batch vectors (we recommend batching 32-128 vectors) and use the batch embeddings API. Also add small sleeps or use the SDK's batch uploader.

sales_zoe: Partner question  can we transfer promo credits to resellers/customers?

cfo_maria: Promo credits are generally applied to the recipient account at issuance and are not transferable. For reseller deals we can structure discounted invoices or org-level promoes during contract negotiation. Contact finance for exceptions.

legal_ravi: Quick legal note  usage policy enforcement can include rate-limiting, throttling, or account suspension for abuse. We aim to notify first and provide remediation steps.

eng_kai: Can teams set hard spend caps so CI jobs don't unexpectedly burn credits?

product_maya: Yes  Console -> Billing has soft and hard cap toggles per project. Soft caps send alerts; hard caps will block traffic once the spend threshold hits. Works for hosted accounts; enterprise customers can request custom controls.

people_ops_anna: How do refunds of unused prepaid credits work? Asking for corporate purchasing.

cfo_maria: Prepaid contract credit refunds are handled as per contract. For standard hosted promos/trial credits we do not refund unused credits. Enterprise billing can negotiate credits/rollover in the contract.

support_bot: [billing-bot] Reminder: Credits and expirations appear under Billing -> Credits; banner shown for expiring credits.

eng_kai: If one project is flagged for abuse, will that impact other projects under the same org?

cto_jen: Typically we isolate remediation to the offending project. In severe or targeted attacks we may apply org-level mitigations; we coordinate with account contacts and post notices in Console.

sales_zoe: Is there a clear doc for recommended packaging for startups vs enterprise (token allotments + rate limits)?

product_maya: We're publishing a packaging playbook next week that outlines recommended project setups: single-prod project, per-service staging projects, org quotas for multi-team orgs, and example token allotments for different workloads. Will link when live.

people_ops_anna: Are trial credits auto-assigned to the first project created or to the org?

cfo_maria: Trial credits are granted at account level and apply across projects under that account, but cannot be moved between separate accounts.

eng_kai: Any changes planned to SDK retry behavior that might affect backoff strategies?

cto_jen: SDKs will default to conservative retry-with-jitter respecting Retry-After. We're adding a config flag to opt into aggressive retries for background jobs. Documented in the SDK changelog.

legal_ravi: Note: customers must not attempt to bypass quotas by creating multiple free accounts; that violates the TOS and can result in enforcement.

people_ops_anna: Thanks everyone  I'll keep thread open for 30m and add the packaging playbook link when Product posts it. :thumbsup:
